meta.notes: FY27 is 20 days old as of 2026-07-20. Per SKILL v3.0.1 rule, the 7 baseline-strip KPIs MUST source from Insights+_v3 PBI dashboard — but PBI typically refreshes at month-end (typically 3-5 business days into a new month), so real FY27 aggregate values are not yet available on the Insights+_v3 dashboard. Interim displayed values are computed from Kusto (KPISupportData.AllCloudsSupportIncidentWithReferenceModelVNext) using the same AgentAlias-based ASW_SAPEpicEsc filter that Insights+_v3 uses upstream. All 7 KPIs are marked `pending_source: 'Insights+_v3'` so the dashboard renders a `K*` pill (asterisk = pending migration from Kusto stopgap to Insights+_v3 authoritative). Refresh recipe: at end of Jul 2026 (early Aug), re-run Skills/asw_caas_lead/scripts/_scrape_insights_v3_fy27.py against the authenticated Insights+_v3 dashboard (external Edge on CDP:9222) with Channel Function Detail=ASW_SAPEpicEsc + Time Fiscal Year=FY2027 only + LastTwelveMonths/LastSixMonths=(All), read the FY27 Total column of the Key Metrics by Date lower grid (Focus Mode + End key technique), then update each KPI's `value` field and switch `source` to `'Insights+_v3'` (drop `pending_source`).
meta.capture_technique: See SKILL §7 Step 2b — Playwright + Focus Mode + `End` key trick for the lower Key Metrics grid Total column. Cannot use Playwright MCP's own browser (Conditional Access blocks); must attach to user's authenticated external Edge via `chromium.connect_over_cdp('http://localhost:9222')`.
